feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
entry.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

entry.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
entry.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

entry.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
entry.summary: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

entry.title: Journalists for CNN, MS NOW and Politico return to the White House upon judge's orders
entry.summary: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

entry.title: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
entry.summary: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

entry.title: Will the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger be Hollywood's undoing?
entry.summary: Now that Paramount has an antitrust suit, the way is clear for a merger. But many say the deal will be the unmaking of Hollywood. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with screenwriter and showrunner Mike Schur.

entry.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
entry.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

entry.title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
entry.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

entry.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
entry.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

entry.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.
